### Findings
The query aggregated item-level records grouped by product catalogue identifier (`id`) within authorized execution scope (products 1 and 2) [q1]. It calculated the average difference between the current catalogue reference price (`products.retail_price`) and the realized item sale price (`order_items.sale_price`) for items where `status = 'Complete'` [q1]. No date filter was applied [q1].

| id | current_reference_gap |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 90.0 |
| 2 | 60.0 |

Across completed items, Product 1 had an average current reference gap of 90.0, and Product 2 had an average current reference gap of 60.0 [q1].

### Limitations
- The metric compares realized prices against the current catalogue reference (`retail_price`), which does not reflect historical list prices or past discount changes [q1].
- The query did not return item counts, order volumes, or transaction dates, so sample sizes and temporal distribution were not measured [q1].
